question: What disqualifying lack of devotion excludes a person from receiving the teaching?
premises: Devotion to the Kula may be absent
Devotion to the guru may be absent
Such absence is emphasized as disqualifying
inference: One devoid of devotion to the Kula and to the guru is unfit.
uncertainties: The qualified noun is implied from surrounding verses
plain_english: But to one who is devoid of devotion to the Kula and deprived of devotion to the guru...
